_comment: Batch 503 (PS-474). Copy to origins.json, fill in this deployment's addresses, then run: node scripts/generate-security-headers.mjs deploy/security-headers/origins.json <outDir>. connect: the API server, the identity provider (OIDC authority), the AI/terminology proxy, the report rendering service. hub: the SignalR live-updates hub (gets a wss:// origin too). formAction: the identity provider, if it posts back. frame/img: anything embedded from another origin (a slide viewer, an image server). https: false only for an internal http deployment (drops HSTS and upgrade-insecure-requests). Full URLs are fine; paths are ignored.
